criteria.text: Parse controlled Anthropic request JSON into a normalized scoring prompt and extract the exact BODY section.
criteria.reason: Controlled Anthropic JSON proves metadata decoys are ignored and only the exact BODY section is returned.

criteria.text: Classify candidate only by exact purpose plus UUID candidate body, uniqueDraft only by exact purpose plus exact rendered generated-draft body, and overlap or wrong-purpose requests as otherScore; require exactly one candidate and one uniqueDraft with exact bodies.
criteria.reason: Executable classification covers candidate, the exact renderWouldBeDraft-equivalent body, overlap body, wrong purpose, exact request bodies, and separate request counts.

criteria.text: Enumerate owned parent relationships, close producers, query status once per cwd, abort only active top-level owned sessions with bounded concurrency four, prove all owned sessions idle, then delete top-level sessions only with DELETE 404 success.
criteria.reason: Static contract binds parent enumeration, top-level selection, per-cwd status proof, active-only abort, idle polling, bounded concurrency, and top-level-only recursive delete.

criteria.text: Fixture closure and provider restoration always run independently before engine status proof; strict cleanup continues after assertion failure and aggregates fatal abort, proof, restoration, database, file, and provider-baseline failures.
criteria.reason: Static contract binds producer shutdown/restoration before status proof and aggregate fatal cleanup semantics.
